| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `addAccount(String nickname, String username, String password)` | Adds an account with the given nickname, username, and password. |
| `addAccount(String nickname, String username, String password, String pin, String totp)` | Adds an account with the given nickname, username, password, bank pin, and totp key |
| `addAccount(String nickname, String username, String password, String pin, String totp, String characterID, String sessionID)` | Adds an account with the given nickname, username, password, bank pin, and totp key |
| `bulkImportAccounts(java.io.File file)` | Bulk imports accounts from a file Formats accepted: JSON: |
| `containsAccount(String nickname)` | Checks if the client has an account with the supplied nickname |
| `containsAccountWithEmail(String email)` | Checks if the client has an account with the supplied email |
| `deleteAccount(String nickname)` | Removes the account with the specified nickname from the accounts list. |
| `getAccountBankPin()` | Gets the currently selected account's bank pin |
| `getAccountHash()` | Hashes the selected account's identifier, which is allowed in SDN scripts (unlike getUsername) This will check for Character ID first, and if that is not present it will use the Account username (email) |
| `getAccountNickname()` | Gets the currently selected account's nickname |
| `getAccountTOTPKey()` | Gets the currently selected account's TOTP key |
| `getAll()` | Gets a list of all account nicknames |
| `hasPin(String nickname)` | Checks if the account matching the given nickname has a bank pin value set |
| `isBanned(String nickname)` | Checks if the account matching the given nickname is set to banned |
| `isLegacyAccount()` | Checks if the current account is a legacy account |
| `setAccount(String nickname)` | Sets the currently selected account based on nickname |
| `setPin(String pin)` | Sets the current account's bank pin |
| `updateAccount(String nickname, String username, String password, String pin, String totp)` | Updates an account based on the given username If an account does not yet exist for this username, a new one will be added |
| `updateAccount(String nickname, String username, String password, String pin, String totp, boolean banned)` | Updates an account based on the given username If an account does not yet exist for this username, a new one will be added |
| `updateBanStatus(String nickname, boolean banned)` | Updates the ban status on an account based on the given nickname. |

### Sleep

**Package:** `org.dreambot.api.utilities`  
**Type:** class  
**Hierarchy:** java.lang.Object → org.dreambot.api.utilities.Sleep → org.dreambot.api.utilities.Sleep  

**Methods:**
```java
static long getDefaultPoll();
static void setDefaultPoll(long defaultPoll);
static void sleep(long ms);
static void sleep(long min, long max);
static void sleepTick();
static void sleepTicks(int ticks);
static boolean sleepUntil(Condition predicate, long timeout);
static boolean sleepUntil(Condition predicate, long timeout, long polling);
static boolean sleepUntil(Condition predicate, Condition resetCondition, long timeout, long polling);
static boolean sleepUntil(Condition predicate, Condition resetCondition, long timeout, long polling, int successfulPolls);
static boolean sleepWhile(Condition predicate, long timeout);
static boolean sleepWhile(Condition predicate, long timeout, long polling);
static boolean sleepWhile(Condition predicate, Condition resetCondition, long timeout, long polling);
```

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `sleep(long ms)` | Sleeps for specified milliseconds Do NOT use this in custom mouse algorithms, as it will cause blocking forever during random events, use Thread#sleep instead |
| `sleep(long min, long max)` | Sleeps for a random number of milliseconds between min (inclusive) and max (exclusive) |
| `sleepTick()` | Sleeps until the start of the next game tick |
| `sleepTicks(int ticks)` | Sleeps through the specified number of game ticks |
| `sleepUntil(Condition predicate, long timeout)` | Sleeps until the passed predicate returns true or sleeping for longer than the timeout. |
| `sleepUntil(Condition predicate, long timeout, long polling)` | Sleep until the given timeout value or condition is met; polling at a rate defined by used. |
| `sleepUntil(Condition predicate, Condition resetCondition, long timeout, long polling)` | Sleep until the given timeout value after a false reset condition or the condition is met. |
| `sleepUntil(Condition predicate, Condition resetCondition, long timeout, long polling, int successfulPolls)` | Sleep until the given timeout value after a false reset condition or the condition is met. |
| `sleepWhile(Condition predicate, long timeout)` | Sleeps until the passed predicate returns false. |
| `sleepWhile(Condition predicate, long timeout, long polling)` | Sleep while the given timeout value or condition is met; polling at a rate defined by used. |
| `sleepWhile(Condition predicate, Condition resetCondition, long timeout, long polling)` | Sleeps while the given timeout value after a false reset condition or the condition is met. |
